description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to a compassionate care environment, supporting the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations and ensuring the highest standards of patient care.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and maintaining regulatory compliance. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and fostering a supportive team atmosphere. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare setting
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and standards
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
